crossRefs.note: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
translations.bsb: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
translations.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
translations.asv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
